text: Westport Albion regain possession near the centre circle on their own half, with Kian Castillo intercepting the ball. They launch a direct, vertical attack, passing quickly up the middle through a series of short, progressive passes involving Castillo multiple times. Castillo then plays a short, precise pass to Rafael Delacroix, positioned just left of center inside the penalty area about 3.5 metres from the goal at the Kingsmoor FC end. Delacroix shoots with his foot and scores, cutting the deficit to 2-1 for Westport Albion at 22 minutes.[#391] [#398] [#401]
